title: Reading Drill — Assessing a new boat storage rack — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Assessing a new boat storage rack — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The boating club caretaker in Cairnford received an old report about shorter users being unable to reach the upper slots. The report compared retrieval time per boat, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the timed trials rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different boat weights. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed lower supports for small boats as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
